# Data Model: Authentication & RBAC (Slice 1)

## Better Auth Tables (generated by CLI, UUID variant)

### user (Better Auth + Peggy additionalFields)
| Field | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK, default gen_random_uuid() |
| name | text | NOT NULL |
| email | text | NOT NULL, UNIQUE |
| emailVerified | boolean | default false, NOT NULL |
| image | text | nullable |
| createdAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |
| updatedAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |
| displayName | text | nullable (additionalField) |
| avatarAssetId | uuid | nullable (additionalField) |
| isActive | boolean | default true (additionalField) |
| isSuperAdmin | boolean | default false (additionalField) |

### session (Better Auth + Peggy revokedAt)
| Field | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | text | PK, default gen_random_uuid()::text |
| expiresAt | timestamp | NOT NULL |
| token | text | NOT NULL, UNIQUE |
| createdAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |
| updatedAt | timestamp | NOT NULL |
| ipAddress | text | nullable |
| userAgent | text | nullable |
| userId | uuid | FK → user.id, cascade |
| revokedAt | timestamp | nullable (Peggy addition) |

### account (Better Auth)
| Field | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | text | PK, default gen_random_uuid()::text |
| accountId | text | NOT NULL |
| providerId | text | NOT NULL |
| userId | uuid | FK → user.id, cascade |
| accessToken | text | nullable |
| refreshToken | text | nullable |
| idToken | text | nullable |
| accessTokenExpiresAt | timestamp | nullable |
| refreshTokenExpiresAt | timestamp | nullable |
| scope | text | nullable |
| password | text | nullable (hashed) |
| createdAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |
| updatedAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |

### verification (Better Auth)
| Field | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | text | PK, default gen_random_uuid()::text |
| identifier | text | NOT NULL |
| value | text | NOT NULL |
| expiresAt | timestamp | NOT NULL |
| createdAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |
| updatedAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |

## RBAC Tables (Peggy-managed)

### roles
| Field | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK, default gen_random_uuid() |
| name | text | NOT NULL, UNIQUE |
| description | text | nullable |
| createdAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |
| updatedAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |

### permissions
| Field | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK, default gen_random_uuid() |
| resource | text | NOT NULL |
| action | text | NOT NULL |
| description | text | nullable |
| UNIQUE(resource, action) | | |

### role_permissions
| Field | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| roleId | uuid | FK → roles.id, cascade |
| permissionId | uuid | FK → permissions.id, cascade |
| PK(roleId, permissionId) | | |

### user_roles
| Field | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| userId | uuid | FK → user.id, cascade |
| roleId | uuid | FK → roles.id, cascade |
| PK(userId, roleId) | | |

## API Tokens

### api_tokens
| Field | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| id | uuid | PK, default gen_random_uuid() |
| userId | uuid | FK → user.id, cascade |
| name | text | NOT NULL |
| prefix | text | NOT NULL (pk_ or sk_) |
| hashedToken | text | NOT NULL, UNIQUE |
| scopes | text[] | NOT NULL, default {} |
| revokedAt | timestamp | nullable |
| lastUsedAt | timestamp | nullable |
| createdAt | timestamp | default now, NOT NULL |

## Relationships

- user 1:N session (cascade delete)
- user 1:N account (cascade delete)
- user N:M role (via user_roles)
- role N:M permission (via role_permissions)
- user 1:N api_token (cascade delete)

## State Transitions

- **Session**: active → revoked (via sign-out or admin revocation) → expired (via expiresIn)
- **ApiToken**: active → revoked (via revoke endpoint) → expired (optional expiresAt)
- **User**: active → deactivated (isActive = false; all sessions/tokens rejected)
